summary: Season 2 (our 25-48; AniList 154364 = 25-36, 166452 = 37-48) adapts the College arc from ch 46 (vol 10) through ch 95 (end of vol 19) in near-linear order; the endpoint ch 95 and continue point ch 96 (vol 20) are confirmed by four sources, and cour 1 ends mid-ch 70 (vol 14). Episode titles mirror the manga chapter titles almost one-to-one, which made the fandom chapter pages (46-97, with volumes) a clean skeleton; per-episode coverage was cross-checked with Kvasir369's 24 per-episode 'Changes from Manga' sections and programming-cafe.com's bidirectional Japanese correspondence table. Non-linear spots: ep 25 pulls ch 48's Alexandra exam forward, ep 28 compresses the Cowl arc (50-52) and drops its church/Stella side threads, eps 29-30 split the interleaved Lucy/Zoe and Alice/Renfred threads of chs 54-57, and ep 43 skips most of ch 83 which ep 44 then adapts. The 2021-22 OVA 'The Boy from the West and the Knight of the Blue Storm' (130713, 3 parts) is anime-original (完全新作), set between ch 45 and ch 46, and belongs after S1 ep 24 / before S2 ep 1 as an order-only entry. No type corrections; existing S1 anchors were not contradicted by two sources (one single-source oddity at ep 12 flagged).

anchors.note: S2E1. Opens in medias res at the College then flashes back to Adolf's visit (= ch 46 per fandom ch 46 synopsis); Lucy roommate + Philomela fainting = ch 47's end. Ch 48's Alexandra exam is pulled forward (Kvasir; programming-cafe lists 46-48 for this reason). Fandom also lists ch 45 (S1-finale continuity; no ch 45 content beyond recap per Kvasir's recap). Ch 47's Narcisse-class/Alice-contract scene is held back to ep 26.

structure.notes: Numbering: Wikipedia and the fandom 'List of Episodes' both number Season 2 as overall 25-48 (S2 in-season N = our 24+N); programming-cafe uses '2-N'; Kvasir uses 'Season 2 Episode N'. AniList (GraphQL, verified): 154364 'Mahoutsukai no Yome SEASON 2' TV 12 eps 2023-04-06..06-22 = our 25-36, adapts chs 46-70 (vols 10-14; newstisiki: 'vol 9's end through vol 14'); 166452 'SEASON 2 Part 2' TV 12 eps 2023-10-05..12-21 = our 37-48, adapts chs 70-95 (vols 14-19; newstisiki: 'latter half of vol 14 through vol 19'); relation 166452 -> PREQUEL 154364. Series endpoint ch 95 (end of vol 19; vol 19 = chs 91-95, vol 20 = 96-100 per fandom volume pages and programming-cafe); continue_from 96 confirmed (animefillerguide, programming-cafe, Kvasir). Volume boundaries used (fandom chapter/volume pages, 5 per volume): v10 46-50, v11 51-55, v12 56-60, v13 61-65, v14 66-70, v15 71-75, v16 76-80, v17 81-85, v18 86-90, v19 91-95, v20 96-100. OVA 130713 'Nishi no Shounen to Seiran no Kishi' (The Boy from the West and the Knight of the Blue Storm): OVA, 3 parts released 2021-09-10 / 2022-03-10 / 2022-09-09 bundled with special editions of manga vols 16/17/18; AniList relation: SEQUEL of 98436. It is an anime-original story ('完全新作アニメーション', eiga.com; WDTALO: 'the OVAs are original content not in the manga'; fandom OVA infobox has no chapter field) set 'during Cartaphilus' brief nap, just prior to Chise becoming a part-time student' (AniList description; eiga.com) — i.e. between ch 45 (S1 ep 24) and ch 46 (S2 ep 1). Watch order: after S1 ep 24 and before S2 ep 1 (fandom nav: OVA part 1 previous = Season 1, S2E1 previous = the OVA; Kvasir reviewed it 'before heading into Season 2'). Not researched here: 'Hoshi Matsu Hito' (Those Awaiting a Star, AniList 21688, OVA 3 eps, 2016-08-13, AniList SIDE_STORY of 98436) — a prequel OVA; adaptation status not verified in this batch. All 24 S2 episodes are manga canon (animefillerguide: 0 filler across 48 episodes); no type corrections.
